mechanism: oslo.messaging 12.4.0 probes endpoint attribute oslo_rpc_server_ping; Nova isolation sentinel rejects the newly introduced access
repair_template: Allow the new oslo_rpc_server_ping capability probe in the existing endpoint-isolation test sentinel

semantic_review.a1_failure: With only the global constraint changed to oslo.messaging 12.4.0, the existing Nova isolation test fails when its NeverCalled endpoint sentinel receives the new oslo_rpc_server_ping attribute probe; the required exclusive signature is 'AssertionError: I should never get called. name: oslo_rpc_server_ping'.
semantic_review.reviewer_basis: The public opening diff changes exactly the oslo.messaging pin from 12.3.0 to 12.4.0; the 12.3.0..12.4.0 package diff adds getattr(ep, 'oslo_rpc_server_ping', None) in RPCDispatcher; the cutoff Nova test permits only target and asserts on every other endpoint access; and the complete maintainer patch adds only oslo_rpc_server_ping to that existing sentinel allowlist without deleting or skipping the test. Fresh replay must still prove 0/nonzero/0, exact installed versions, and signature exclusivity.
semantic_review.source_effect: oslo.messaging 12.4.0 adds RPCDispatcher's getattr probe for the reserved endpoint attribute oslo_rpc_server_ping; 12.3.0 lacks that access.
semantic_review.target_repair: The complete maintainer patch preserves the existing isolation sentinel and allows only oslo_rpc_server_ping in addition to the pre-existing target probe, so every other unexpected endpoint access still asserts.
